Ticket.title: Civic Ticket
Ticket.description: A municipal issue report submitted by a signed-in citizen with live server-side Gemini triage recommendation and lifecycle timeline.

id.description: Human-readable ticket identifier matching document ID (e.g., CR-2026-AB12CD).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the citizen who submitted the report.

ownerEmail.description: Verified email address of the reporting citizen.

ownerName.description: Display name of the reporting citizen.

title.description: Concise issue headline submitted by the citizen.

description.description: Detailed report description provided by the citizen.

location.description: Street address, intersection, or landmark for the civic issue.

status.description: Ticket lifecycle status progressed exclusively by allowlisted admins.

triageStatus.description: Whether live Gemini triage completed or fell back to pending_review.

recommendedCategory.description: AI-recommended municipal category or Pending review when unavailable.

recommendedDepartment.description: Fixed municipal department deterministically mapped from recommendedCategory.

urgency.description: Validated urgency level from Gemini or Pending review when unavailable.

triageReason.description: Short rationale explaining the triage recommendation or pending review fallback.

triageModel.description: Identifier of the model used or unavailable.

imageDataUrl.description: Optional compressed JPEG/PNG/WebP data URL preview (capped <= 180KB).

resolutionNote.description: Required municipal resolution note written by an admin when resolving the ticket.

assignedAdminUid.description: UID of the last admin who updated the ticket status.

assignedAdminEmail.description: Email of the last admin who updated the ticket status.

timeline.description: Bounded chronological array of status transition entries (max 5 entries).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial ticket creation.

createdAtMs.description: Client epoch ms mirror used strictly for deterministic UI ordering.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent ticket update.

updatedAtMs.description: Client epoch ms mirror of last update.

resolvedAt.description: Server timestamp recorded when admin moves ticket to Resolved.

resolvedAtMs.description: Client epoch ms mirror of resolution time.

AdminAllowlistEntry.title: Admin Allowlist Entry
AdminAllowlistEntry.description: Console-managed allowlist document at /admins/{uid} granting municipal triage admin privileges.

email.description: Optional reference email for the allowlisted administrator.

grantedBy.description: Optional note of who added the document in Firebase Console.

/tickets/{ticketId}.description: Owner-scoped citizen civic issue reports; readable by owner or allowlisted admin, writable on create by authenticated owner, status-updatable only by allowlisted admins.

/admins/{uid}.description: Console-managed allowlist of admin Firebase Auth UIDs. Users may only check existence of their own /admins/{request.auth.uid} document; all client writes and list queries are denied.
